from pathlib import Path
import collections
base=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-rnd0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u010/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for value in row:
            counts[value] = counts.get(value, 0) + 1
    background = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    source = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value not in (background, 0)]
    target = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 0]
    sr0, sr1 = min(r for r, c in source), max(r for r, c in source)
    sc0, sc1 = min(c for r, c in source), max(c for r, c in source)
    tr0, tr1 = min(r for r, c in target), max(r for r, c in target)
    tc0, tc1 = min(c for r, c in target), max(c for r, c in target)
    for i in range(tr1 - tr0 + 1):
        for j in range(tc1 - tc0 + 1):
            out[tr0 + i][tc0 + j] = grid[sr0 + i][sc1 - j]
    return out
'''
f=base/'task-f5a41e77.py'
f.write_text(code)
exec(compile(code,str(f),'exec'),globals())
demo=[[2]*12 for _ in range(12)]
rows=[[1,3,3,1],[1,1,3,1],[1,3,3,3],[1,1,1,1]]

print('demo match',transform(demo)==expect)

for i in range(9,12): test[i][2:6]=[0]*4
result=transform(test)
print('file',f)
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in result))
